doctrine.legacyRole: Legacy Benton/PACS data is upstream input, not operational truth.
doctrine.syncRole: TerraFusion Sync is a bridge/projection layer, not source truth.
doctrine.demoRole: Washington 39-county data remains demo/reference unless county-specific official source, lineage, sync, and recomputation proof promote it.
doctrine.soloDevRule: Every important metric gets one blessed definition, one blessed read path, one proof artifact, and one visible trust posture.

contracts.population: active County Studio segment-set parcel rollup
contracts.purpose: County command/workbench health view for operational triage, not Statistics Studio parity.
sourceOfTruth: CountySegment rows in the active segment set
trustPosture: county-data-trust-tier required
Benton production_provisional until row-level qualification lineage closes
39-county reference_demo cannot prove operational health
forbiddenUses: Do not compare directly against qualified-sale ratio-study parity.
Do not treat as statewide production proof.
Do not recompute client-side.

patterns: must not be used interchangeably with health-summary

contracts.population: qualified sale ratio rows using the shared Statistics/TerraForge ratio-study population contract
contracts.purpose: Same-population parity lens between County Studio and TerraForge/Statistics ratio-study analytics.
trustPosture: statistics parity proven only for the exact shared population
Benton qualification fields remain converted_legacy_sensitive until sync lineage closes
Operational Health remains a different population
forbiddenUses: Do not substitute for operational health.
Do not hide conversion-sensitive qualification counts.
Do not use Benton reference-only lanes as parity evidence.

contracts.population: canonical parcels grouped by neighborhood, reval area, building type, and quality grade for an active county study
contracts.purpose: Derive governed CountySegmentSet and CountySegment rows from canonical TerraFusion DB tables.
sourceOfTruth: Benton PACS valuation metadata for neighborhood/cycle when available
trustPosture: direct-source recomputation required for production confidence
Benton sync-derived and converted-legacy-sensitive fields must stay visible
39-county reference_demo cannot certify segment derivation
forbiddenUses: Do not derive from UI fixture data.
Do not silently substitute Benton defaults for another county.
Do not collapse segment derivation into Statistics Compat.

contracts.population: County Studio active segment alerts ranked for correction and defense workflow
contracts.purpose: Determine which segment/cohort problems route first into correction, approval, exception, and evidence workflows.
trustPosture: uses operational health population, not Statistics Compat population
defense packet must carry segment-level trace
exceptions remain workflow state, not metric truth
forbiddenUses: Do not let AI summaries invent priority outside the composite risk contract.
Do not rank demo/reference counties as production correction work.
Do not export defense packets without segment-level trace.

contracts.population: CostForge county-scoped neighborhood calibration matrix rows with minimum sale-count filtering
contracts.purpose: Rank neighborhoods for CostForge calibration triage using COD deviation, median-ratio deviation, PRB deviation, and sale-count exposure.
sourceOfTruth: Equity decile endpoint for county-wide vertical-equity context
trustPosture: CostForge calibration priority is a cost-calibration triage contract, not County Studio correction priority.
Requires county-scoped runtime and neighborhood matrix source data.
Do not treat 39-county demo/reference data as production calibration proof.
forbiddenUses: Do not substitute for County Studio correction priority.
Do not rank production correction work from demo/reference counties.
Do not change formula weights or thresholds without updating this contract and proof artifact.

contracts.population: Atlas Live county context resolved from County Studio route scope and Washington launch/county trust posture
contracts.purpose: Prevent Benton operational/provisional data, 39-county reference/demo data, geometry availability, and production-claim posture from being treated as the same trust class.
sourceOfTruth: Atlas route scope from County Studio handoff
trustPosture: Benton is production_provisional, sync_derived, and converted_legacy_sensitive until lineage and conversion-sensitive sales qualification proof closes.
Washington 39-county launch/reference corpus is reference_demo and not certified for operational valuation.
Geometry availability is launch context, not proof of production valuation data.
forbiddenUses: Do not treat 39-county launch/reference data as official production data.
Do not infer production readiness from geometry availability alone.
Do not hide Benton converted-legacy sensitivity when presenting county context.

contracts.population: CompsForge county sales shard candidates for the active parcel or County Studio rollup handoff scope, followed by Benton-certified CostForge adjustment/reconciliation where supported
contracts.purpose: Keep comparable-sales candidate selection, qualified-sale filtering, sale-window scope, top-candidate selection, and governed reconciliation from becoming unversioned UI logic.
sourceOfTruth: County Studio rollup handoff metadata when no parcel subject is active
trustPosture: Candidate selection is county-shard scoped and may run in rollup scouting mode, but scoring and reconciliation remain parcel-bound.
Qualified-only filtering defaults to true and the default sale window is 2016-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
Governed paired adjustment and reconciliation are Benton-certified only until additional county proof is promoted.
forbiddenUses: Do not treat rollup scouting sales as parcel-bound reconciled value evidence.
Do not treat non-Benton adjustment/reconciliation as certified without promoting county proof.
Do not change qualified-only defaults, sale window, candidate cap, or default selected count without updating this contract and proof artifact.

patterns: governed adjustment and reconciliation remain Benton-certified

rejectWhen: metric logic has no registered contract
demo/reference data is used as production proof
County Studio health is compared directly to Statistics Compat
